scanNote:
GRAMMAR REFERENCE, 9-BET (124-bet). Yuqorida chapda 'Grammar Reference'.

CHAP USTUN:
OCh KO'K QUTI: 'Time expressions used with the past perfect simple: before, after, just, already etc.'
'PAST CONTINUOUS/PAST PERFECT/PAST SIMPLE': • We use the past continuous for an action which was in progress in the past. 'He was walking in the street when it started raining.' • We use the past perfect for an action which had finished before another action happened. 'He had entered his house when it started raining.' • We use the past simple for an action which happened at a specific time in the past. 'He woke up early yesterday.'
Ko'k 'UNIT 9'. 'THE PASSIVE (to be + past participle)'. 'Form': 'We form the passive with the verb to be and the past participle of the main verb.' KO'K JADVAL: Active | Passive: He washes the car. | The car is washed. He washed the car. | The car was washed. He has washed the car. | The car has been washed. He will wash the car. | The car will be washed.
'Use': • We use the passive when we want to show that the action of the verb is more important than the person who carries out the action. 'The bank robber was caught yesterday. (The action is more important than the person who caught the bank robber.)'
'CHANGING FROM ACTIVE INTO PASSIVE'. JADVAL: active: subject Kim | verb baked | object a cake. passive: subject A cake | verb was baked | agent by Kim.

O'NG USTUN:
a) The object of the active sentence becomes the subject in the passive sentence. b) The active verb changes into a passive form. c) The subject of the active sentence becomes the agent.
'Study the following table:' JADVAL: active | passive: present simple: She cleans the house. | The house is cleaned. past simple: She cleaned the house. | The house was cleaned. present perfect simple: She has cleaned the house. | The house has been cleaned. future simple: She will clean the house. | The house will be cleaned. modal: She must clean the house. | The house must be cleaned.
• We form questions by putting the verb to be before the subject. 'Was the car made in Japan?' • The agent (the person who carries out the action) is introduced with by and is mentioned only when the identity of the agent is important or needs to be stated. 'The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell. (The identity of the agent is important.)' • The agent is not mentioned when: a) it is unknown. 'Don's van was damaged in the car park. (We don't know who damaged Don's van.)' b) it is unimportant. 'Spaghetti is eaten in Italy. (The agent is unimportant.)' c) it is obvious from the context. 'The mail has been delivered. (It is obvious who did it - the postman.)'
Yashil 'UNIT 10'. 'IMPERATIVE': 'We use the imperative to tell people what to do/not to do. Put a gate at the top and bottom of your stairs. Don't let your children near the stove.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '124'.

exercises.instructionEn: Time expressions used with the past perfect simple: before, after, just, already. Past continuous / past perfect / past simple compared.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan tugallangan zamon vaqt iboralari: before, after, just, already. O'tgan davomli / o'tgan tugallangan / o'tgan oddiy zamonlar qiyosi.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChTA O'TGAN ZAMON - BIR VAZIYaT:

  PAST CONTINUOUS - DAVOM ETAYoTGAN
  edi:
    'He WAS WALKING in the street
     when it started raining.'
    (yurayotgan edi - yomg'ir
     boshlandi)

  PAST PERFECT - OLDIN TUGAGAN edi:
    'He HAD ENTERED his house when
     it started raining.'
    (kirib bo'lgan edi - keyin
     yomg'ir)

  PAST SIMPLE - ANIQ VAQTDA bo'ldi:
    'He WOKE UP early yesterday.'


PAST PERFECT VAQT IBORALARI:
  before = oldin
  after = keyin
  just = hozirgina (o'shanda)
  already = allaqachon (o'shanda)


⚠ 'WHEN' bilan:

  was walking WHEN = yurayotganda
  had entered WHEN = kirib bo'lgan
    edi, o'shanda


⚠ 'TO ENTER':

  = kirmoq.


⚠ 'TO WAKE UP':

  woke - woken. = uyg'onmoq.

points.en: Time expressions used with the past perfect simple: before, after, just, already etc.
points.uz: O'tgan tugallangan zamon vaqt iboralari: before, after, just, already va h.k.

points.en: We use the past continuous for an action which was in progress in the past. He was walking in the street when it started raining.
points.uz: O'tgan davomli zamonni o'tmishda davom etayotgan ish uchun ishlatamiz. U ko'chada yurayotganda yomg'ir boshlandi.

points.en: We use the past perfect for an action which had finished before another action happened. He had entered his house when it started raining.
points.uz: O'tgan tugallangan zamonni boshqa ish bo'lishidan oldin tugagan ish uchun ishlatamiz. Yomg'ir boshlanganda u uyiga kirib bo'lgan edi.

points.en: We use the past simple for an action which happened at a specific time in the past. He woke up early yesterday.
points.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamonni o'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda bo'lgan ish uchun ishlatamiz. U kecha erta uyg'ondi.

exercises.instructionEn: The Passive (to be + past participle). We form the passive with the verb to be and the past participle of the main verb. He washes the car. → The car is washed. He washed the car. → The car was washed. He has washed the car. → The car has been washed. He will wash the car. → The car will be washed. Use: when the action is more important than the person who carries it out.
exercises.instructionUz: Majhul nisbat (to be + 3-shakl). Majhul nisbatni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli bilan yasaymiz. U mashinani yuvadi. → Mashina yuviladi. U mashinani yuvdi. → Mashina yuvildi. U mashinani yuvgan. → Mashina yuvilgan. U mashinani yuvadi (kelajak). → Mashina yuviladi. Ishlatilishi: ish uni bajaruvchidan muhimroq bo'lganda.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT (THE PASSIVE).

  BE + FE'LNING 3-ShAKLI


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
    She cleans the house. →
    The house IS CLEANED.
  PAST SIMPLE:
    She cleaned the house. →
    The house WAS CLEANED.
  PRESENT PERFECT:
    She has cleaned the house. →
    The house HAS BEEN CLEANED.
  FUTURE SIMPLE:
    She will clean the house. →
    The house WILL BE CLEANED.
  MODAL:
    She must clean the house. →
    The house MUST BE CLEANED.

  ⚠ 'be' ZAMONNI ko'rsatadi; asosiy
  fe'l HAR DOIM 3-shaklda.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ISh bajaruvchidan MUHIMROQ
  bo'lganda:
  'The bank robber WAS CAUGHT
   yesterday.'
  (kim tutgani muhim emas - tutilgani
   muhim)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  FAOLDAN MAJHULGA O'TISh         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  FAOL: Kim (ega) baked (fe'l) a
        cake (to'ldiruvchi).
  MAJHUL: A cake (ega) was baked
        (fe'l) by Kim (bajaruvchi).

  a) Faol gap TO'LDIRUVChISI →
     majhul gap EGASI
  b) Faol fe'l → majhul shakl
  c) Faol gap EGASI → 'BY' +
     bajaruvchi


⚠ 'THE AGENT':

  = bajaruvchi (ishni qiluvchi).


⚠ 'TO CARRY OUT':

  = bajarmoq.


⚠ 'A BANK ROBBER':

  = bank o'g'risi.

points.en: We form the passive with the verb to be and the past participle of the main verb. He washes the car. → The car is washed. He washed the car. → The car was washed. He has washed the car. → The car has been washed. He will wash the car. → The car will be washed.
points.uz: Majhul nisbatni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli bilan yasaymiz. U mashinani yuvadi. → Mashina yuviladi. U mashinani yuvdi. → Mashina yuvildi. U mashinani yuvgan. → Mashina yuvilgan. U mashinani yuvadi. → Mashina yuviladi.

points.en: We use the passive when we want to show that the action of the verb is more important than the person who carries out the action. The bank robber was caught yesterday.
points.uz: Majhul nisbatni ish uni bajaruvchi odamdan muhimroq ekanini ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lganimizda ishlatamiz. Bank o'g'risi kecha tutildi.

points.en: Changing from active into passive: a) The object of the active sentence becomes the subject in the passive sentence. b) The active verb changes into a passive form. c) The subject of the active sentence becomes the agent. Kim baked a cake. → A cake was baked by Kim.
points.uz: Faoldan majhulga o'tish: a) Faol gapning to'ldiruvchisi majhul gapda ega bo'ladi. b) Faol fe'l majhul shaklga o'zgaradi. c) Faol gapning egasi bajaruvchi bo'ladi. Kim tort pishirdi. → Tort Kim tomonidan pishirildi.

points.en: Table: present simple - The house is cleaned; past simple - was cleaned; present perfect simple - has been cleaned; future simple - will be cleaned; modal - must be cleaned.
points.uz: Jadval: hozirgi oddiy - The house is cleaned; o'tgan oddiy - was cleaned; hozirgi tugallangan - has been cleaned; kelasi oddiy - will be cleaned; modal - must be cleaned.

exercises.instructionEn: Questions: Was the car made in Japan? The agent is introduced with by and is mentioned only when the identity of the agent is important. The agent is not mentioned when it is unknown, unimportant or obvious from the context.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollar: Mashina Yaponiyada yasalganmi? Bajaruvchi 'by' bilan kiritiladi va faqat kimligi muhim bo'lganda aytiladi. Bajaruvchi noma'lum, ahamiyatsiz yoki kontekstdan aniq bo'lsa aytilmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL SAVOL:
  'be' egadan OLDIN:
  'WAS the car made in Japan?'
  'HAS the house been cleaned?'


BAJARUVChI (AGENT) - 'BY':

  AYTILADI - kimligi MUHIM bo'lsa:
  'The telephone was invented BY
   Alexander Graham Bell.'

  AYTILMAYDI:
  a) NOMA'LUM bo'lsa:
     "Don's van was damaged in the
      car park." (kim - bilmaymiz)
  b) AHAMIYaTSIZ bo'lsa:
     'Spaghetti is eaten in Italy.'
     (kim yeydi - muhim emas)
  c) KONTEKSTDAN ANIQ bo'lsa:
     'The mail has been delivered.'
     (pochtachi - aniq)


⚠ 'IDENTITY':

  = shaxs, kimlik.


⚠ 'A VAN':

  = furgon.


⚠ 'TO DAMAGE':

  = zarar yetkazmoq, shikastlamoq.


⚠ 'OBVIOUS':

  = aniq, ravshan.


⚠ 'TO DELIVER':

  = yetkazib bermoq.


⚠ 'THE MAIL':

  = pochta (xatlar).

points.en: We form questions by putting the verb to be before the subject. Was the car made in Japan?
points.uz: Savollarni 'to be' fe'lini egadan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. Mashina Yaponiyada yasalganmi?

points.en: The agent (the person who carries out the action) is introduced with by and is mentioned only when the identity of the agent is important or needs to be stated. The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
points.uz: Bajaruvchi (ishni qiluvchi odam) 'by' bilan kiritiladi va faqat kimligi muhim bo'lganda yoki aytilishi kerak bo'lganda tilga olinadi. Telefon Alexander Graham Bell tomonidan ixtiro qilingan.

points.en: The agent is not mentioned when: a) it is unknown. Don's van was damaged in the car park. b) it is unimportant. Spaghetti is eaten in Italy. c) it is obvious from the context. The mail has been delivered.
points.uz: Bajaruvchi aytilmaydi: a) noma'lum bo'lsa. Donning furgoni avtoturargohda shikastlangan. b) ahamiyatsiz bo'lsa. Italiyada spagetti yeyiladi. c) kontekstdan aniq bo'lsa. Pochta yetkazildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Imperative. We use the imperative to tell people what to do/not to do. Put a gate at the top and bottom of your stairs. Don't let your children near the stove.
exercises.instructionUz: Buyruq mayli. Buyruq maylini odamlarga nima qilish/qilmaslikni aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Zinangizning yuqori va pastiga panjara qo'ying. Bolalaringizni pech yoniga qo'ymang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ MAYLI (IMPERATIVE).

  IJOBIY: FE'L (asosiy shakl)
    'PUT a gate at the top of your
     stairs.'
  INKOR: DON'T + FE'L
    "DON'T LET your children near
     the stove."

  ⚠ Ega YO'Q ('you' tushiriladi).
  ⚠ Ko'rsatmalar, ogohlantirishlar,
  qoidalar uchun (10-unit -
  xavfsizlik).


⚠ 'A GATE':

  = panjara, darvoza.


⚠ 'A STOVE':

  = pech, plita.


⚠ 'TO LET':

  = qo'ymoq, ruxsat bermoq.

points.en: We use the imperative to tell people what to do/not to do. Put a gate at the top and bottom of your stairs. Don't let your children near the stove.
points.uz: Buyruq maylini odamlarga nima qilish/qilmaslikni aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Zinangizning yuqori va pastiga panjara qo'ying. Bolalaringizni pech yoniga qo'ymang.

patterns.formula: EGA + is/was/has been/will be + V3 (+ by ...).
patterns.exampleEn: The house is cleaned. The telephone was invented by Bell.
patterns.exampleUz: Uy tozalanadi. Telefon Bell tomonidan ixtiro qilingan.

patterns.exampleEn: Was the car made in Japan?

patterns.formula: X was + -ING when Y + PAST. / X had + V3 when Y + PAST.
patterns.exampleEn: He was walking when it started raining. He had entered his house when it started raining.
patterns.exampleUz: U yurayotganda yomg'ir boshlandi. Yomg'ir boshlanganda u uyiga kirib bo'lgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: Put a gate at the top of your stairs. Don't let your children near the stove.
patterns.exampleUz: Zinangiz yuqorisiga panjara qo'ying. Bolalaringizni pech yoniga qo'ymang.
